instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE through the graphical user interface to perform a linear buckling analysis of a thin plate (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Model Definition:
Create a 3D Deformable Shell planar part. Sketch a square plate from (0, 0) to (96, 96) in the X-Y plane.

Material and Section:
Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Homogeneous Shell Section with a thickness of 1.2 mm and 5 through-thickness integration points, and assign it to the entire plate.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the plate.

Analysis Step:
Create a Linear Perturbation Buckle step named Step-Buckle-A. Request 3 eigenvalues.

Discretization:
Mesh the plate with a global seed size of 6 mm. Assign S4R shell elements and generate the mesh.

Loads and Boundary Conditions:
Apply the compressive edge load of 1.2 N/mm on the two vertical edges as equivalent nodal forces after meshing. On the X = 0 edge, apply nodal forces in the positive X direction. On the X = 96 edge, apply nodal forces in the negative X direction. With an edge length of 96 mm and mesh spacing of 6 mm, apply 7.2 N to each interior edge node and 3.6 N to each corner edge node on each loaded vertical edge.

Apply U3 = 0 on all four plate edges (X = 0, X = 96, Y = 0, and Y = 96) to represent simply supported transverse conditions. At the center mesh node approximately located at (48, 48, 0), constrain U1 = U2 = 0 to suppress in-plane translational rigid-body motion. At the bottom-edge midpoint mesh node approximately located at (48, 0, 0), constrain U1 = 0 only to suppress the remaining in-plane rotational rigid-body mode.

Job Execution:
Create a job named Job-Buckle-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully.

Post-Processing:
Review the first buckling mode and record the first eigenvalue.

Deliverables:
Save the model database as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Buckle-A.cae and ensure the output database is written to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Buckle-A.odb.
